wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/compiler.p.name: Safety rules installer
wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/compiler.p.description: Turns a run's allowed-files scope into live protection rules, installs them for the run and restores the previous settings afterwards.

wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/cost.py.name: Run cost tracking
wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/cost.py.description: Reports how long each run and step took and, once recorded, how many AI tokens it used; unknown cost is shown as unknown, never zero.

wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/durable.py.name: Crash-proof build waves
wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/durable.py.description: Runs build waves in order, and when a durable-workflow database is configured, keeps going after a crash instead of starting over.

wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/engine.py.name: Main work engine
wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/engine.py.description: Plans a run, hands out the next small work packet, and accepts or rejects each result against the safety rules, rolling back rejected work.

wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/escalation.name: Escalations
wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/escalation.description: Records a problem that needs the owner on the run's timeline and in a founder-facing notifications file, and lists them newest first.

wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/known_fail.name: Declared test failures
wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/known_fail.description: Lets a human declare narrow, environment-only test failures so the test check warns instead of blocking, using the list as committed.

wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/learning.p.name: Lessons from past runs
wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/learning.p.description: Mines past runs for improvement proposals that a human must review; nothing is ever applied automatically.

wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/observabil.name: Run health monitor
wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/observabil.description: Reads what runs left on disk, flags warning signs, raises serious ones to the owner and builds a plain dashboard.

wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/pipeline.p.name: Build step order
wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/pipeline.p.description: Defines the ordered steps for build, improve and review jobs and loads each step's written instructions.

wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/plan_lint..name: Work-split checker
wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/plan_lint..description: Checks that a plan cuts work by responsibility rather than by file count, and saves the findings next to the plan.

wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/regression.name: Regression guard
wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/regression.description: Records a green test baseline before changes and flags anything that was passing and now fails, including changed tests.

wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/reproducib.name: Rebuild check
wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/reproducib.description: Regenerates generated files in a clean copy of the code and confirms they match byte for byte.

wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/resume.py.name: Resume after crash
wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/resume.py.description: Checks which step outputs exist on disk after an interruption and moves the run back to the right step to continue.

wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/run_store..name: Run history log
wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/run_store..description: Saves each run's timeline and evidence to disk safely so a run can be inspected or resumed later.

wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/schemas.py.name: Shared data definitions
wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/schemas.py.description: Defines the fixed shapes of runs, steps, work packets, risk levels and results that every other part relies on.

wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/steps/impr.name: Improve: understand
wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/steps/impr.description: Instructions for the first improve step: read the existing product and understand what it does before touching it.

wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/steps/impr.name: Improve: find the spot
wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/steps/impr.description: Instructions for finding exactly which parts of the code the requested improvement should change.

wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/steps/impr.name: Improve: make the change
wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/steps/impr.description: Instructions for making the improvement in small, in-scope edits.

wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/steps/impr.name: Improve: check nothing broke
wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/steps/impr.description: Instructions for proving the change did not break anything that worked before.

wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/steps/impr.name: Improve: final check
wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/steps/impr.description: Instructions for the last verification of an improvement before it is accepted.

wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/steps/qual.name: Quality loop overview
wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/steps/qual.description: Instructions that run the repeated score, critique and patch cycle until the work is good enough.

wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/steps/qual.name: Quality: score the work
wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/steps/qual.description: Instructions for giving the work a 0 to 5 quality score and listing what holds it back.

wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/steps/qual.name: Quality: expert critiques
wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/steps/qual.description: Instructions for independent critics to review the work from different angles and report problems.

wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/steps/qual.name: Quality: hostile review
wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/steps/qual.description: Instructions for a deliberately sceptical reviewer who tries to find what the others missed.

wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/steps/qual.name: Quality: targeted fixes
wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/steps/qual.description: Instructions for fixing only the problems the critics found, without rewriting everything.

wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/steps/qual.name: Checking claims method
wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/steps/qual.description: Explains how to verify statements about state, such as tests passing or work merged, before reporting them.

wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/steps/revi.name: Review: understand
wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/steps/revi.description: Instructions for the first review step: read the target and understand what it is meant to do.

wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/steps/revi.name: Review: critique
wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/steps/revi.description: Instructions for the review panel to look for problems in the target without changing it.

wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/steps/revi.name: Review: write report
wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/steps/revi.description: Instructions for turning the critics' findings into one clear review report.

wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/traceabili.name: Requirement tracing
wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/traceabili.description: Checks that every requirement from the shaping notes shows up in the plan and contract, and lists any that were dropped.

wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/wave_plann.name: Parallel wave planner
wilfred/src/hyperwilfred_core/wave_plann.description: Groups independent slices of work into waves that can run side by side without touching the same files.
